## ⚠ THINGS A COLD SEAT SHOULD KNOW BEFORE IT TOUCHES ANYTHING

- ⛔★★ **A SUBAGENT HAS NO AGENT TOOL, SO A CHAIN CONDUCTOR CANNOT BE DELEGATED FROM THIS HARNESS.** Lane NC at 18:38 BST found none in three searches and handed back. The session conductor launches every lane itself; plan a long night around its own window.
- ⛔★★ **WHEN A LANE BRIEF LISTS EXAMPLES, HIS WORD SPREADS FURTHER THAN HE MEANT.** *"it needs an edge but only a bottom edge"* went from three named surfaces to more than a dozen; at 23:18 he kept it for the mega menu alone. Before building past the surfaces he named, put the scope to him.
- ⛔★ **CLOUD LANES HAND BACK PATCHES; ONE COMMITTER APPLIES THEM WITH `git apply --3way`.** Twenty-six at #313, three conflicts resolved, no whole-file overwrite (`notes/_lanes/313/LANE-RULES.md`).
- ⚠ **`/dev/shm` AT THE SEAT DOES NOT SURVIVE BETWEEN `device_bash` CALLS.** Unpack what a later call needs into a gitignored folder on the mount, such as `knowledge/_tmp/`.
- ⚠ **QUOTE THE FILL FROM A HAND SUM AT THE TIME YOU QUOTE IT.** The conductor's "about 295,000" was true before 23:18 and not at its end.
- ⛔ **Window lines (`s305-D62`, `s305-D64`):** stop 300,000 · limit 320,000 · hard 350,000 · `BOOT_CEILING_TK` 135,000. This session booted under the ceiling, crossed the stop at 23:18 and stayed under the limit.
- ⛔ **Project memory: none at the opener, none while the chat is live.** The note is placed only after he says he is done.
- ⛔★★ **NEVER RUN `git status`.** After every gate run, `python3 knowledge/_wrap_commit.py unlock --tag <n>-<seat>`.
- ⛔★★ **AN INSCRIPTION IS NOT DONE UNTIL `python3 knowledge/gen_kg_titles.py --write` AND `python3 knowledge/_render_rulings.py` RUN AND COMMIT WITH IT.**
- ⛔★★ **THE CONDUCTOR'S OWN PUSH RUNS THE PRE-PUSH CHECK TOO** (`s309-D7` names lanes; a conductor push is a push).
- ⛔★★ **READ THE FILL BETWEEN LANES:** at the cloud seat, sum `cache_read + cache_creation + input` on the last usage record of the conductor transcript.
- ⚠ **Commit msgfile line 1 carries NO `#<n> date —` prefix** (the script adds it; a reused file is refused); non-wrap commits need `SESSION_N=<n>`.
- ⚠ **The state-contrast sweep takes about 2 min per slice at the seat:** three or four slices per call.
- ⛔ **`device_bash` DEFAULTS TO A 120 s TIMEOUT.** Pass `timeout_ms` (up to 178000) on a commit.
- ⚠ **Other-seat paths stay dirty by declaration** (the W report names them); the transcripts in `knowledge/_tmp/wrap313/` are gitignored.
- ⛔★ **THE BOOT IS THE FIRST USAGE RECORD**, not the fill after the opener reads.
